# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by `agent-in-browser tools --markdown` (task docs:tools). Do not edit by hand. -->

Every tool is available over MCP, via `agent-in-browser call <tool>`, and as a scenario step.

## `browser_close`

Close the browser launched by agent-in-browser. The next tool call starts a fresh one.

_No arguments._

## `browser_status`

Show the connected browser (launching it if needed), protocol, current tab and open tabs.

_No arguments._

## `browsers_installed`

List browsers detected on this machine and whether they can be driven.

_No arguments._

## `click`

Click an element (by ref, selector or visible text) or page coordinates with real mouse events. The element is scrolled into view first.

_No arguments._

## `console_messages`

Console messages and uncaught errors captured since this server attached to the tab. Filter by level or regex pattern.

_No arguments._

## `evaluate`

Run JavaScript in the page and return the JSON result. A bare expression is returned as is (e.g. document.title); multi-statement code must use `return`. Promises are awaited.

_No arguments._

## `fill_form`

Set values of several fields at once (inputs, textareas, selects by value or label, checkboxes/radios with true/false). Fires input/change events so frameworks (React/Vue/Angular) notice.

_No arguments._

## `find`

Find visible elements whose text, label, placeholder, id or name contains the query. Returns refs.

_No arguments._

## `get_text`

Return the visible text of the page (or of a CSS selector) — good for reading articles, results and messages.

_No arguments._

## `hover`

Move the mouse over an element or coordinates (reveals menus/tooltips).

_No arguments._

## `navigate`

Navigate the tab to a URL, or go back/forward/reload. Waits for the page to load and returns its title and URL.

_No arguments._

## `network_requests`

Network requests captured since attaching to the tab, with status. Filter by URL regex or failures only.

_No arguments._

## `press_key`

Press a key or combination on the focused element, e.g. Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown, Control+a, Meta+Shift+k.

_No arguments._

## `resize`

Emulate a viewport size (e.g. 390x844 for a phone, 1440x900 for desktop).

_No arguments._

## `screenshot`

Capture the visible viewport as PNG. Returned as an image; set path to also save it to disk.

_No arguments._

## `scroll`

Scroll the page (or a scrollable element) by direction/amount, or scroll an element into view.

_No arguments._

## `snapshot`

Return a compact accessibility-style outline of the page: headings, landmarks and every visible interactive element with a ref (e.g. [ref=e12]) to use with click/type/fill_form. Prefer this over screenshots for understanding page structure. mode=all also includes text content.

_No arguments._

## `tab_close`

Close a tab (default: current). Another tab becomes current.

_No arguments._

## `tab_new`

Open a new tab (optionally at a URL) and make it current.

_No arguments._

## `tab_select`

Make a tab current (and bring it to front).

_No arguments._

## `tabs_list`

List open tabs. The current tab (default target of page tools) is marked with *.

_No arguments._

## `type`

Type text with real keyboard input. If an element is given it is focused (and optionally cleared) first; otherwise text goes to the focused element. submit=true presses Enter afterwards.

_No arguments._

## `wait_for`

Wait until text appears, a CSS selector is visible, or the URL contains a string (gone=true waits for the opposite). With only ms, just sleeps.

_No arguments._
